summary: AI-moderated video research and a continuous consumer-insight workspace for enterprise teams.
editor_note: Unlike cheaper interview transcription, the product connects study design, recruitment, AI-moderated video interviews, synthesis and reusable evidence. StoryLines keeps recurring topics running so teams can query a growing research base; Conveo says more than 70% of final insights arise during AI follow-ups. That compounding workflow is the real bet. The metric is company-reported, while validity still depends on sampling, moderation and analysis.
tags: market research,consumer insights,video interviews,AI agents,enterprise software
investors: DST Global, Balderton Capital, Visionaries Club, 6 Degrees Capital, Y Combinator

product_evidence.claim: The product surface connects study setup, participant recruitment, AI-moderated video interviews, analysis and research deliverables in one workflow.
The Series A announcement describes StoryLines as continuous research on recurring topics, with a shared record that teams can query in natural language.
Conveo says the platform supports multimodal analysis of speech, tone, expression and on-screen context; VentureDex did not independently reproduce those analyses.

market_context.primary_user: Consumer-insight, product, marketing and strategy teams at large brands.
market_context.differentiation: Recurring video research accumulates into a searchable consumer-context layer instead of ending as disconnected study files.
market_context.why_now: The financing supports United States expansion and the shift from individual studies toward an enterprise-wide research system.

risks.claim: Research validity depends on sampling, moderation and synthesis quality, while published adoption and speed metrics are company-reported rather than independently audited.
risks.basis: VentureDex assessment based on Conveo's product and Series A materials.
